notes.title: Major update V1.46
notes.notes: [p]Thank you for all your amazing feedback! After a month of work, here’s what’s new:[/p][h3]🔧 Optimizations[/h3][list][*][p]Faster texture loading.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved lighting & effects (no quality loss).[/p][/*][*][p]Simplified enemy spawn calculations → less lag.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized AI processing → smoother gameplay with large armies.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🧠 Smarter AI[/h3][list][*][p]Enemies now take cover behind obstacles – flank them for max damage![/p][/*][*][p]Allied units defend themselves [b]and[/b] protect nearby allies.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🐞 Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Units getting stuck behind rocks/trees when taking cover.[/p][/*][*][p]Unit group formation issues in some languages.[/p][/*][/list][h3]✨ Other Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Red circle cursor when area is inaccessible.[/p][/*][*][p]Countdown icon added to thrown dynamite.[/p][/*][*][p]French translation fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Russian translation fixed.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]🔥 More updates are coming – keep sharing your feedback to help us improve![/p]

notes.title: Performance Optimization
notes.notes: [p]I’m currently working on improving the game’s performance. Some progress has already been made, and I hope to release an update very soon![/p][p] With this upcoming update, the game should run much more smoothly and adapt to a wider range of PC configurations without losing graphical quality. [/p][p]Thank you for helping us improve the game with your feedback.[/p]

notes.title: Major Upgrade V1.44
notes.notes: [h3]Major Updates[/h3][list][*][p][b]Group Creation[/b] → Use [b]Alt + Num (0–4)[/b] to create groups and select them with the numpad. Strategy just got smoother![/p][/*][*][p][b]Camera Overhaul[/b] → No more shaky terrain-following. The camera now glides softly across the map. Zooming in slows movement for better unit tracking, and rotation is capped to avoid a flat top-down view.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Mini-map Power-Up[/b] → Move across the battlefield with a click, and even select units directly from the mini-map.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Minor Updates[/h3][list][*][p]Added [b]keyboard shortcuts[/b] to the pause menu (Esc now opens/closes pause and sub-menus).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a [b]unit selection bug[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]In the unit bar, [b]double-click an icon[/b] to select all soldiers of that type.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved Korean translation[/b] (thanks to a translator upgrade!).[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Upcoming Patch Preview
notes.notes: [p]I’ve read all your feedback, and a big update is on the way. Here’s what’s planned:[/p][list][*][p]Smoother camera movement[/p][/*][*][p]Keyboard shortcuts to create and select unit groups[/p][/*][*][p]Double-clicking a unit icon in the unit bar to select all units of that type[/p][/*][*][p]Escape key to enter and exit the pause menu[/p][/*][*][p]Camera movement by clicking on the minimap[/p][/*][*][p]Improved translations[/p][/*][/list][p]This should take no more than a week.[/p][p]More improvements will come later, but I can’t confirm a date yet. Some ideas include: a more flexible building system, improved AI, and skirmish battle maps.[/p]

notes.title: A Fistful on Yankees is Available Now!
notes.notes:
[p]It's time!  A Fistful of Yankees is now available! [/p][p align="start"][/p][previewyoutube="nUvkJ6euSgE;full"][/previewyoutube][h3][b]A Little About the Game:
[/b][/h3][h3]✨ The West Is Lawless. Bring the Law.[/h3][p align="start"]It’s 1865, and your orders are simple: head west, take command, and bring order to the frontier. But nothing out here stays simple for long. Every outlaw has a price. Every town hides a secret. And your squad’s survival depends on how fast—and how smart—you can draw.[/p][p align="start"][/p][h3]✨ RTS Combat with a Six-Shooter Twist[/h3][p align="start"][i]A Fistful of Yankees[/i] blends tactical real-time battles with cinematic spaghetti western style. Take cover, flank enemies, and unleash special abilities in gritty skirmishes across badlands, forests, and forgotten mining camps. This ain’t your usual duel—it’s war on the frontier.[/p][p align="start"][/p][h3]✨ One Last Campaign for the Stars and Stripes[/h3][p align="start"]Manage your soldiers, conserve your prestige, and make the tough calls as you chase a conspiracy bigger than any one outlaw. From scorched desert canyons to misty northern woods, every mission brings you closer to the truth—and closer to the edge of no return.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2936470/A_Fistful_Of_Yankees/"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3]🎉 [b]Celebrate & Save During Launch[/b][/h3][h3][i]To celebrate the game's launch, the game will be [b]20% off until August 29th[/b]!

[/i][b]💞 How You Can Support Us[/b][/h3][p]As a small indie team, there are so many ways you can help support us and the game.[/p][list][*][p]If you buy the game, please consider leaving an honest review on Steam! Reviews have a massive impact on indie games and we'd love to see your thoughts and experiences through a review. So many indies are discovered with a simple share or casual discussion.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]If you have any thoughts after playing — whether it’s a suggestion, a balance tweak idea, or something that doesn’t seem to be working as intended — we’d love to hear from you![/b] You can share your feedback in our [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/2936470/discussions/1/"]Steam Discussion Thread.[/url]

Thanks to everyone who’s been following the project and for your support![/p][p align="start"]— The [i]A Fistful of Yankees[/i] Team[/p]

notes.title: Strap on your boots, it’s almost time !
notes.notes: [p]After months of development, updates based on your feedback, and final polishing, our western RTS is finally ready to hit your PC. Step into the boots of a Yankee general and experience a unique adventure. Recruit your troops, build defenses on key strategic points, and gain the upper hand in accessible yet tactical real-time battles.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Why should you play it?[/b][/p][p][/p][h3]🏜️ [b]A unique, comic book-style western universe[/b][/h3][h3]⚔️ [b]A story-driven solo campaign with at least 6 hours of gameplay[/b][/h3][h3]🧠 [b]Designed for fans of strategy and adventure without the headache[/b][/h3][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]👉 In the meantime, don’t forget to [b]wishlist the game [/b]to stay updated and support the launch![/p][p][/p][p]Thanks to everyone who’s been following the project from the start.[/p][p]See you soon![/p][p]— The [i]A Fistful of Yankees[/i] Team[/p]

notes.title: Improvements
notes.notes:
Many improvements have been made to the game:

[list]
[*] You can now select a unit category with a double left-click

[*] Yankee cavalry behavior is now more predictable

[*] GUI improvements (centered text, more information)

[*] Additional information has been added to cover elements (number of slots, protection bonus)

[*] Camera movement has been reworked (move by bringing the mouse to the edge of the screen, prevents the camera from clipping through scenery, smoother motion)

[*] More frequent auto-save points

[*] No more prestige needed to upgrade units. Units now upgrade automatically based on the number of enemies they eliminate

[*] Numerous bugs have been fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: Camps management
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] [b]Captured Camps Become Bases:[/b] Captured enemy camps can now be used as bases, allowing players to establish new strongholds and manage their operations more effectively.

[*] [b]Recruitment from Multiple Strategic Points:[/b] Units can now be recruited from captured camps, improving deployment flexibility and battlefield strategy.

[*] [b]Building Construction at Multiple Bases:[/b] Players can now construct buildings in various captured camps, expanding their base management and territorial control.

[*] [b]New Construction Animation:[/b] Instead of an instant cinematic, buildings now require soldiers to complete construction, adding realism and strategic depth to the building process.
[/list]

notes.title: Game Updated
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
I'm thrilled to announce that the game is progressing by leaps and bounds! New levels have been added to the campaign, featuring the surprise arrival of Confederate troops and new enemy and allied units. A new skill has been introduced for the captain, allowing them to call in an artillery strike.

The flag capture system has been improved, along with the AI and unit aiming system. Additionally, work has been done to optimize the game, making it run smoother than ever.

Most of these changes will be available in the full version of the game. In the meantime, I encourage you to add the game to your wishlist so you don't miss anything and to subscribe to the PulsarCreation Discord and YouTube channel.

notes.title: Official Publisher Announcement
notes.notes:
For those of you who may not know, working with a game publishing platform like indie.io greatly helps indie developers focus on game development while they handle all the behind-the-scenes magic. From helping manage store pages to crafting marketing campaigns and even helping the game shine at both digital and live events, indie.io helps in all the aspects that indie developers often struggle with alone.

A Fistful of Yankees is our first game, and we wanted to maximize our chances of reaching a wider audience. Additionally, Indie.io provides us with support in several areas, such as marketing, allowing us to focus all our energy on developing the game.

Indie.io publishes amazing games that you can check out by following this link :
https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/indieio 

Working with Indie.io is a fantastic opportunity for us, and we’re thrilled to continue this adventure with them! Thanks to this partnership, we hope to deliver the best game possible!

Don’t forget to follow us on our social platforms (Discord, YouTube, Twitter, Reddit) and add the game to your Wishlist so you don’t miss a thing!
